newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Minnesota Mining rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Minnesota Mining rating cut.

text.p: - Prudential Securities Research Tuesday cut its rating on Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Corp to a hold from a buy after the stock broke through Prudential's long-term target price.
- Prudential's B. Alex Henderson said the cut was prompted by the stock's recent climb after an analysts'meeting in August.

"The rating cut was based on 3M shares romping through our short-term forecast two weeks ago and hitting our long-term target Monday," Henderson said. "Their new product portfolio was a factor (in the stock climbing) in recent weeks, plus the fact that the market is narrowing toward high-profile names."

- Henderson said that 3M shares have gained 28 percent since the August meeting, which he characterized as positive. "But given the deceleration in the economy overall, the earnings may not hit higher levels. We're just moving toward more conservative investments with less cyclical pressure," said Henderson.
